policy: Authored lessons, not parity fixtures. Qualify actual runtime frames, ordinary playback, declared replay capabilities and responsive framing before publication. Captured posters are generated by scripts/showcase-capture.mjs; never substitute illustrations or Manim renders. Exact-source references remain unchanged.
